description: Explains the OSHA Hazard Communication (HazCom) 2024 update employer dates (employers update as necessary by 20 Nov 2026 for substances and by 19 May 2028 for mixtures) and what a facility that stores chemicals needs in place (current safety data sheets, GHS container labels, a written program, and documented employee training), then points to a free, no-signup readiness self-audit. Does NOT invent fines, statistics, or legal conclusions. Use it when someone asks what their business needs under OSHA HazCom or how to prepare for those dates.

industry.description: Optional: the kind of facility (e.g. "auto repair shop"), used only to tailor the wording.

name: check_hazcom_readiness
title: OSHA HazCom 2024 update — the employer dates and how to check readiness
